subject: Ink file rev 3 after Ziggy's rulings (relayed by NQ Claude): holster dropped as the default, the ring is terms only; dispatch from 95c42de4…, not 8cf54aef…
body:
Supersedes af5ef4dc's pointer. NQ Claude relays Ziggy's rulings, given to him directly, and rev 3 of the ink file is on disk in both homes: references/From NotebookLM/NQ-NAGUAL-R3-20261013/INK_JAMES_GROK_PROMPT_20261014.md, sha256 95c42de4da145df1471f6fb9bf69378459b2d518570dfcfe361c8b63082b677b, 11,179 bytes; package MANIFEST.csv 6616cfdb011ea8989f48c3cc62d4ab61dd43ee3f7825d4bc54e6d4bab892b6ad; both verified by me at 05:42 UTC. This is the version to paste to Grok when Ziggy gives the word; rev 2 (8cf54aef…) is superseded.

The rulings as relayed (recorded in DECISIONS item 58, rev 3; Ziggy may correct them in the session): (1) the holster is dropped as the default; James does not carry it; it may come back later, in which case only the prompt's reference line changes; the prompt again keeps the v004 clean reference "no gun, no holster"; my empty-holster proposal stays on file as the alternative. (2) The outer ring: Ziggy delegated the call to NQ Claude, who took the cautious side; no book sentence on the skin; the ring reads THE KNOWN on the upper arc and THE UNKNOWN on the lower, with the two anthropological terms small beneath; one language on the whole body; the seven-word quote stays in the file for off-skin use. (3) Sides as rev 2, both ways, no mirror. Open item 23 now holds only the lock itself, after Grok's rev 3 return and Ziggy's look. I have corrected the note I posted to the Chief's chat at about 05:38 UTC, which pointed at rev 2 and said the holster question was untouched. No run requested by me.

attachments.description: The ink map and corrective Grok prompt, rev 3 (holster dropped; ring terms only; sides both ways). The paste version.

source: NQ Claude by session message, 2026-10-14 about 05:40 UTC, relaying Ziggy's rulings given to him directly; both homes verified by the writer.
